items.item_text: Bachelor's degree in related field or equivalent experience.
Minimum of 5 years of administrative experience in an office setting.
Minimum of 5 years experience in customer service team lead or management position.
Extensive experience with the back-end operations and management of a POS (point-of-sale) system.

Front-of-House Operations & Customer Service Welcoming Guests: Serving as the primary point of contact for museum visitors, answering questions about exhibitions, events, facility amenities, schedules, and general policies. Occasionally greets large tour groups of youth and adults, reviews general policies, and connects them with docents (tour guides). Ticketing & Admissions: Managing the point-of-sale (POS) system for admission tickets, membership sign-ups, tour registrations, and special event check-ins. Conflict Resolution: Handling visitor complaints, accommodating special needs/accessibility requests, and resolving ticketing or scheduling issues professionally. Gift Shop & Retail Support: Sharing oversight of museum store sales, stocking merchandise, taking inventory, and maintaining retail displays. (25% time)

Staff Supervision & Team Leadership Scheduling: Building and managing shifts for student workers, front-desk assistants, docents, and shift leads to ensure adequate coverage for regular gallery hours and special events. Recruiting & Training: Recruiting, hiring, and training frontline staff. Equipping frontline staff and volunteers with training on customer service standards, ticketing software, emergency protocols, and current exhibition details. Daily Leadership: Conducting daily team huddles, assigning floor roles (e.g., ticket desk, gallery monitoring), and supervising staff performance during open hours. (25% time)

Financial Handling & Reporting Cash Management: Managing daily cash drawers, balancing till registers, preparing bank deposits, and performing end-of-day financial reconciliations. Data Tracking: Collecting and tracking daily visitation metrics, demographic data, attendance trends, and sales reports for museum leadership. (25% time)

Safety, Accessibility & Venue Operations Gallery Readiness: Inspecting public spaces, lobby areas, and galleries continuously throughout the day to ensure clean, safe, and functional environments. Safety Protocol Enforcement: Acting as a key responder for emergency situations (evacuations, medical incidents, lost children) and ensuring staff enforce security rules to protect art and artifacts. Event & Group Support: Coordinating logistics for group tours, school field trips, and facility rentals. Building Security: Locking and alarming buildings at closing. Hiring security staff for select events and evening hours as needed. (25% time)
